{{Quote|TK-934, you know The Infinite Nebstar Casino and Hotel is absolutely off limits to the rank and file.|Official reprimand from Eastern Arch Platoon Leader Ton E'rau|<ref name="TFUII" />}}
'''TK-934''' was<ref name="TFUII" /> a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="SQ" /> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] sometime during the reign of the Galactic Empire.<ref name="TFUII" /> At one point between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="date">The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was formed during the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places in the year [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Since the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' occur in the year [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] according to the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|tie-in comic]], it can be concluded that TK-934 was alive during that time.</ref> TK-934 was reprimanded by [[Eastern Arch Platoon]] [[Platoon leader/Legends|Leader]] [[Ton E'rau]] for the fact that [[Unidentified enlisted trooper|certain]] stormtroopers for which TK-934 was responsible participated in activities at the [[Infinite Nebstar Casino]] against regulations. In the reprimand, E'rau noted that they had prevented word of the infractions from reaching the planet's [[Baron/Legends|Baron]], [[Merillion Tarko]], E'rau threatened to demote TK-934 if action was not taken to prevent such activities.<ref name="TFUII" />

==Behind the scenes==
TK-934 was mentioned in "The [[Infinite Nebstar Casino]]" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', a [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released in [[2010]].
